description: Explicit residual-risk acceptance decisions only. An entry requires a named human approver and evidence. Absence of an entry means no exceptional acceptance is inferred.
owner_role: MLRO / Board as required by risk appetite and decision rights
rules: Never create an acceptance from a CI result, generated dashboard, model response or silence.
Every entry must reference a risk_id in docs/aims/ai-risk-register.md.
Every entry must include accepted_by, decision_date, review_by or expiry_date, rationale and an evidence path containing the recorded human decision.
Above-appetite risks without an explicit valid entry remain in the decision/treatment queue.
